description: US-government public-domain documents for fed-quarterly. For each as-of date T the agent gets the latest document of each kind whose 'published' date is strictly before T; nothing else.
license: Public domain (works of the Federal Reserve Board, BLS, BEA and the U.S. Treasury).

kinds.fomc_minutes: FOMC minutes: staff review of the economy + policy discussion (dated by release day)
kinds.fomc_sep: Summary of Economic Projections table: dot-plot medians (latest before T)
kinds.bls_cpi: BLS CPI news release, summary text (CPI and core CPI)
kinds.bls_jobs: BLS Employment Situation, summary text (unemployment, payrolls)
kinds.bea_pce: BEA Personal Income and Outlays release (PCE and core PCE inflation, spending)
kinds.treasury_yields: Treasury par yields: 3m, 2y, 10y and curve spreads, dated before T
